newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds weaken after U.S. jobs data.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds weaken after U.S. jobs data.

text.p: Austrian bonds slumped on Friday after U.S. jobs data that indicated a strong economy and raised fears the Fed Reserve may increase interest rates at its next meeting. Drop accelerated by NAPM data, dealers said.
* 10-year benchmark 5.625 pct bond maturing July 2007 down 30 bps at 100.20 to yield 5.60 (5.56) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 99.74/82 to yield 5.66/65 pct.
* Five-year 4.625 bond maturing May 2002 down 30 bps at 99.60 to yield 4.72 (4.64) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 99.28/38 to yield 4.79/77 percent.
* Austrian bond future down 95 bps at 109.58.
* 10-year spread over Germany steady at six bps, five-year spread at 21 bps.
* Money market rates three-month VIBOR at 3.430 and overnight money at 3.13/3.38.
